تقتطفين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِفِينَ (taqtaṭifīna) /taq.ta.tˤi.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# تُقْتَطَفِينَ (tuqtaṭafīna) /tuq.ta.tˤa.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
